admin-tshirts.record.absent.description: Presence of an attendee who has not checked in, on the t-shirt desk's record.

admin-tshirts.record.archived.defaultMessage: This attendee is archived. The T-shirt cannot be handed over.
admin-tshirts.record.archived.description: Banner on an archived attendee's t-shirt record. No hand-over control is offered.

admin-tshirts.record.close.description: Accessible name of the record's close button. Returns to an empty search.

admin-tshirts.record.codeHint.defaultMessage: Ask for the last four digits of the registered phone number and check them before handing over.
admin-tshirts.record.codeHint.description: Explains the verification code under it, for the person at the desk.

admin-tshirts.record.confirm.description: Label of the armed hand-over button: a second press records the t-shirt as collected, which cannot be undone on this screen. Reverts after a few seconds.

admin-tshirts.record.duplicate.description: Warning toast when the hand-over was refused as a duplicate: the shirt had already been collected. The record under it shows when.

admin-tshirts.record.failed.defaultMessage: Could not record the hand-over. Try again.
admin-tshirts.record.failed.description: Error line when recording the hand-over failed for a reason the server did not explain.

admin-tshirts.record.forbidden.defaultMessage: You no longer have permission to record T-shirt hand-overs.
admin-tshirts.record.forbidden.description: Toast when the t-shirt desk permission was withdrawn while the record was open.

admin-tshirts.record.pending.description: State of a t-shirt that was not collected yet.

admin-tshirts.record.presentNumber.description: Presence of an attendee who checked in and holds arrival number {number}.

admin-tshirts.record.redeem.description: Button that records the t-shirt as handed over. {size} is the size the attendee ordered.

admin-tshirts.record.redeemHint.defaultMessage: Record the hand-over only after checking the verification code and handing over the T-shirt. The hand-over cannot be undone on this screen.

admin-tshirts.record.redeemed.description: Toast on the record's page after the operator recorded the t-shirt as handed over.

admin-tshirts.record.redeemedAt.description: State of a t-shirt that was already collected. {time} is the date and time of the collection, in the event's time zone.

admin-tshirts.record.redeeming.description: Label of the hand-over button while the request is in flight.

admin-tshirts.record.showCode.description: Summary of the collapsed panel holding the attendee's verification code. Kept closed until asked for: the code is the check-in's only shared secret.

admin-tshirts.record.size.description: Label of the t-shirt size on the record.

admin-tshirts.record.status.description: Label of the collection state on the record: collected, or not yet.

admin-tshirts.search.absent.description: Tag on a result card for somebody who has not checked in. Lowercase: it trails the role badge.

admin-tshirts.search.count.defaultMessage: {total, plural, =1 {{total, number, ::group-off} result} other {{total, number, ::group-off} results}}
admin-tshirts.search.count.description: Number of matching attendees above the results.

admin-tshirts.search.idle.defaultMessage: Type a name, ticket code or phone number to start.

admin-tshirts.search.lede.defaultMessage: Search by name, ticket code or phone number to find who is entitled to a T-shirt and record the hand-over.
admin-tshirts.search.lede.description: Line under the t-shirt desk heading.

admin-tshirts.search.miss.description: No result. {query} is the search as typed, trimmed and lowercased.

admin-tshirts.search.missHint.defaultMessage: Check the selected status: someone who already collected their T-shirt only appears under “Collected” or “All”.
admin-tshirts.search.missHint.description: Suggestion after a search with no result. The quoted names are the labels of the status choices.

admin-tshirts.search.pending.description: Tag on a result card for a t-shirt that was not collected yet.

admin-tshirts.search.redeemedAt.description: Tag on a result card for a t-shirt already collected. {time} is the date and time of the collection, in the event's time zone.

admin-tshirts.search.status.description: Legend of the status choice (not collected, collected, all). The choice applies on the next search.

admin-tshirts.search.status.all.description: Status choice: everybody with a t-shirt, collected or not.

admin-tshirts.search.status.pending.description: Status choice: t-shirts not yet collected. The default.
